high_level_description: The image shows a smartphone displaying its lock screen. The lock screen is personalized with a photo of two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left appears to be an older individual wearing a white traditional outfit with a black shirt underneath. The person on the right seems younger, dressed in a gray T-shirt featuring a graphic design that includes a face. The lock screen also displays the date and time: "Sunday 1:13 September 1." There is a small lock icon at the top left corner of the screen, indicating that it is indeed a lock screen.
